stories.short: Backlog record porte par les data centers
stories.story_fr: Au deuxieme trimestre fiscal 2026, le carnet de commandes atteint un record de 20 Mds $, en hausse de 26% en organique, porte par la demande en refroidissement de data centers et les environnements technologiques a forte croissance ou JCI se differencie.
stories.story_en: In fiscal Q2 2026, backlog reached a record $20 billion, up 26% organically, driven by demand in data centers and high growth, technology driven operating environments where JCI differentiates.
stories.signal: Orders grew 30% and backlog reached a record $20 billion, reflecting strength in data centers and other high growth, technology driven operating environments where we differentiate.

stories.short: Leadership en refroidissement avance de data centers
stories.story_fr: JCI revendique un leadership technologique en refroidissement avance de data centers et en solutions de decarbonation, un positionnement qui le distingue alors que les clients demandent de plus en plus d'innovation de pointe.
stories.story_en: JCI claims technology leadership in advanced data center cooling and decarbonization solutions, a positioning that sets it apart as customers increasingly demand cutting-edge innovation.
stories.signal: Our technology leadership in advanced data center cooling and decarbonization solutions continues to set us apart, as customers increasingly demand cutting-edge innovation and bold sustainability outcomes that only true technology leadership can deliver.

stories.story_fr: Joakim Weidemanis, veteran de Danaher avec 13 ans de carriere et une experience de mise a l'echelle de societes technologiques mondiales, est devenu CEO de Johnson Controls le 12 mars 2025, succedant a George R. Oliver.
stories.story_en: Joakim Weidemanis, a Danaher veteran with a 13-year career and experience scaling global technology businesses, became CEO of Johnson Controls on March 12, 2025, succeeding George R. Oliver.
stories.signal: He held several executive leadership roles over his 13-year career at Danaher Corporation providing him with extensive experience scaling global companies from a foundation of customer orientation, innovation and efficiency.
